headline: Canadian Envoy Urges Mexican Businesses to Accelerate Direct Investment
summary: Canadian Ambassador Cameron MacKay encouraged Mexican companies to invest in Canada, pointing to favorable corporate tax rates and strategies to bypass waning US interest in regional integration.
why: North American cross-border direct investment flows shape supply chains and trade dynamics ahead of the scheduled USMCA trade agreement review.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Diplomatic initiatives seek to attract Mexican corporate capital into the Canadian economy.
